summary: This study tested a drug called CS0159 combined with Semaglutide in patients with a serious liver disease called Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH), obesity, and type 2 diabetes. The research looked at changes in body weight over a period of 16 weeks. A total of 62 participants took part in the trial. The study is now completed.
